title: Knowledge Graph Paradigm Shift
definition: The transformation of isolated data storage into a connected network of interrelated knowledge nodes.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a library's card catalog turned into a web of interconnected ideas. This is how CADMIES could be enhanced with Sophia, creating a network of concepts that talk to each other.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: CADMIES can leverage Sophia's support for Linked Data and RDF standards to create a knowledge graph, allowing concepts to be linked, queried, and reasoned upon.
difficulty_levels.expert: The integration of CADMIES with Sophia leads to a paradigm shift in knowledge systems, enhancing interoperability and enabling advanced querying and reasoning capabilities. This has philosophical implications for the nature of knowledge and its role in the Semantic Web.

extra_fields.insight: By transforming data storage into a knowledge graph, CADMIES can greatly enhance its capabilities and contribute to the broader Semantic Web.
